- The changes in `CLIParser.java` establish the groundwork for handling the `-dryrun` option in the command-line interface, allowing it to be processed without raising exceptions when it is used correctly.
- The `MockCoordinatorEngineService.java` modification complements the CLI changes by ensuring that the backend service can appropriately respond to dry run requests, thus enabling the CLI to function as intended.
- The new test cases in `TestOozieCLI.java` validate the modifications made in both `CLIParser.java` and `MockCoordinatorEngineService.java`, ensuring that the dry run functionality works correctly and that the system behaves as expected under various scenarios.
